title: A10 Symmetry Auditor verdict
description: pass or block on the symmetry gate, with reasons. A10 returns a judgment and nothing else: the `token` field is minted by the runner over the candidate bytes on a pass, because a sha256 is not something a language model can compute. A block with no reasons is not a verdict anyone can act on, so the schema demands at least one.

reasons.description: On a block, one entry per asymmetry found: which treatment differed, on which side, and where.

token.description: Written by the runner, never by the slot.

model.description: The identity the agent reports from its own system context.
